claim: The mined corpus is identity-pinned and every later count is traceable to it.
evidence: 43 files, 81,007,695,609 bytes, 3,358,182 lines; record-manifest sha256 8e9b7999...41d00; 0 unparsed records
confounders: one JSON parse of one corpus - contract prices this LOW, not NONE
safe_thesis_wording: The analysed record set is pinned by a record-manifest digest that any later gate can regenerate.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not call the corpus a census of retron diversity in nature.

claim: Record, locus, exact RT, taxonomic occurrence and RT-ncRNA pair are non-equivalent units, and none converts to another by a constant.
evidence: 3,059,700 records -> 2,847,312 loci -> 2,475,684 physical loci -> 501,561 exact RTs; loci per exact RT 1.11 (mgnify_soil) to 5.49 (ncbi_bacteria)
confounders: database-specific redundancy is the measured object, not a confounder
safe_thesis_wording: The phrase 'unique system' is undefined unless the unit is named; conversion factors between units vary by source database.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not quote a single 'number of retrons' without naming the unit.

claim: RT protein and genomic coordinates agree by back-translation for 99.47% of RT-family records.
evidence: 3,034,472 of 3,050,688 verified; 618 mismatches RETAINED; independent Biopython re-implementation 1,999/2,000; frame-shift negative control agrees 0 times
safe_thesis_wording: Coordinates and sequences are mutually consistent for 99.47% of records, verified by an independent implementation with a negative control.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not present this as validation of the upstream mining pipeline's biology.

claim: The frozen mapper transfers to one fresh RT lineage under one match-state convention.
evidence: all 7 predeclared UG25 conditions met; genealogy audit shows 0 exact overlaps with construction data and 0 of 28 sequences meeting the full link rule
confounders: construction substrate is 66 group II intron ORFs containing ZERO retrons
safe_thesis_wording: Under hhmake -M 50, the frozen mapper met all seven predeclared conditions in a single confirmatory run on one fresh lineage.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not claim universal RT architecture, transfer beyond UG25, robustness under -M a2m, or equivalence under -M 60.

claim: The eligible Stage-2 denominator is 369,381 exact RTs, of which 354,102 are inspectable.
evidence: 369,381 of 501,561 (0.7365); 354,102 MAPPED (0.9586); 15,279 frozen abstentions; 0 tool failures; 55,407,150 state rows
confounders: eligibility is NON-UNIFORM: 11.3% eligible for mixed/codon evidence vs 73.6% catalogue-wide
safe_thesis_wording: G5_ELIGIBLE_N = 369,381 is the denominator for every g5/g6 rate; the eligibility filter removed 26.35% of the catalogue unevenly.
prohibited_overclaim: Never use 501,561 as the denominator for a mapper-derived rate. Abstention is not biological absence.

claim: Among catalytic-state-mapped sequences, 0.9653 carry a [YF].DD residue at that state.
evidence: 343,880 of 356,229 CAT-mapped; construction agreement 0.9857
confounders: CAT_STATE 262 is not one of the 150 anchors; the two measurements are never pooled
safe_thesis_wording: Among sequences where the catalytic state was mapped, 96.53% carry the expected catalytic motif residue.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not pool this with anchor callability, and do not present it as accuracy against external truth.

claim: RT0 and RT1 cannot be given an operational coordinate by this instrument.
evidence: zero frozen anchors fall in LtrA 1-85 or 39-61; anchor reach is LtrA 97-363; 0 of 62 experimental structures carry RT0/RT1 states
confounders: both historical (no stated boundary; Malik 1999 not held) AND instrumental
safe_thesis_wording: RT0 and RT1 are UNRESOLVED / NOT IDENTIFIABLE for historical and instrumental reasons; they may be discussed only as historical concepts.
prohibited_overclaim: Non-observability is NOT biological absence. RT0/RT1 may not be resolved by inference, analogy, interpolation or structural reasoning.

claim: RT3, RT4, RT5+RT6 and RT7 correspond to frozen state intervals on LtrA.
evidence: 4 ESTABLISHED / 2 PARTIAL / 2 UNRESOLVED, all upheld on independent review (7/10, 0 blockers); RT4 splits into 3 in the independent frame (Jaccard 0.410)
confounders: Route C is corroboration of placement, not independent historical replication (E-g7a-1)
safe_thesis_wording: Frozen states overlap a literature-supported PORTION of the named historical region, LtrA-locally; RT5 must be named jointly as RT5+RT6.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not present these as universal RT0-RT7 domains or as residue-level accuracy against external truth.

claim: The mapper-derived descriptor is reproducible across annotation-defined family strata.
evidence: split-half rho 0.9865 (36 families) on halves sharing no sequence cluster; exceeds the cluster-level null p99 (0.9066) but NOT the sequence-level null p99 (0.9906)
confounders: the grouping IS MyRT's; leakage 11.2% of hits / 19.8% of sampled queries; 26 of 50 retron subtype strata never entered a distance matrix
safe_thesis_wording: g6 supports reproducibility of a mapper-derived descriptor across MyRT-defined strata - concordance, not independent discovery of biological family structure.
prohibited_overclaim: BLOCKED on the evidence: thesis-level biological claims, classification reassessment, and any claim of independent validation. The two nulls are sensitivity analyses, not proven bounds.

claim: RT chains decompose into three reproducible compact fingers/palm/thumb units.
evidence: palm-like called in 0.565 of 46 primary chains against a predeclared 0.70 bar; thumb-like 0.130; fingers-like 0.304; 22/22 LOGO folds FAIL; group-level 12/22 = 0.545
confounders: all 31 groups fall in ONE structural cluster; no biological positive control - HIV-1 1RTD_A is itself AMBIGUOUS
safe_thesis_wording: Under PDP plus predeclared secondary-structure rules, a three-way fingers/palm/thumb partition is NOT recovered on 46 experimental RT chains.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not say 'RT chains have no palm'. The negative is specific to this parser AND these thresholds.

claim: The PDP partition is itself replicate-stable.
evidence: unit count agrees in 20/52 replicate pairs = 0.385
safe_thesis_wording: The structural partition is unstable across replicate structures of the same protein (38.5% agreement).
prohibited_overclaim: Do not treat any single PDP partition as the structure of that protein.

claim: A motif-blind geometric rule identifies the RT catalytic site.
evidence: Tier B never opened; K5 decoy-sufficiency criterion FIRED (legitimate pool 23 vs required >=60); only in-sample Tier-A calibration exists (13/19 = 0.684); out-of-sample LOCO 12 HIT / 5 MISS / 2 ABSTAIN
denominator: 19 truth-bearing Tier-A chains (Tier B: 17, never evaluated)
confounders: SEP_MIN 75, SEP_MAX 115 and D_MAX 6.0 A were each derived from these SAME truth pairs; each window edge is set by a single chain
safe_thesis_wording: Stage 3B produced in-sample calibration material only; it stopped on a kill criterion before any held-out evaluation.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not report 0.684 as detector performance. Do not describe the track as 'CLOSED at PARTIAL' - PARTIAL means a bounded-scope PASS on Tier B, which never happened.

claim: Stage 3C establishes a reproducible catalytic-centre architecture.
evidence: independent review (Codex, model-disjoint) FAIL_BLOCK 4.5/10 with 5 blockers, ALL UPHELD after the author re-derived each number
confounders: the instruments are NOT mutually independent (erratum E-3C-9); CAT_STATE 262 was constructed as the modal HMM state of [YF].DD motif starts, so its 2-residue offset is an expected motif-identity check (E-3C-4)
safe_thesis_wording: Across nonuniform subsets of a selected register, mapped sequence-state blocks and Tier-A non-retron catalytic labels often occupy a large PDP unit. 'Conserved core plus variable accessory architecture' remains a HYPOTHESIS.
prohibited_overclaim: NOTHING from Stage 3C may be promoted. The 13/14 replicate figure is not the declared analysis (truth-bearing scope: 7/7 from TWO groups vs 0/7). No retron catalytic-architecture conclusion follows - all 19 truth-bearing chains are non-retron.

claim: Retron Region Y is a universal, retron-diagnostic motif-anchored region.
evidence: Region Y defined in 15/21 retron chains; ALL SIX Retron-Eco8 chains carry no VTG-like triplet; VTG is present in 4 non-retron chains
confounders: rule frozen before scanning (K9); controls passed (literature motif positions 9/9, YxDD 19/19, SUBSTRATE_NA 44/44, shuffle null 4/3300)
safe_thesis_wording: In this structure panel the VTG-anchored Region Y is neither universal among retrons nor exclusive to them.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not claim a universal Region-Y motif. Note the terminology hazard: group II intron 'domain X' is the thumb; retron 'Region X' lies between RT2 and RT3.

claim: Region X is observable and carries a characteristic motif.
evidence: under the launcher-declared two-block rule Region X is defined in 24/62 chains and 3/21 retron chains, and NONE of those 24 intervals contains NAXXH or AXXH; all reported motif hits came from an UNDECLARED wide-window fallback
confounders: the reported hits are exploratory and are not pooled with the primary analysis
safe_thesis_wording: Under the declared rule, Region X is undefined in 38 of 62 chains and no declared interval contains the expected motif.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not quote the 33/62 coverage or the 4 strict / 2 relaxed motif hits - they come from an undeclared window.

claim: Region Y is enriched for RNA-contacting residues and could contribute to pairing specificity.
evidence: retron contact-concentration ratio 1.34x its chain-length fraction (median over 15 chains from FIVE groups; range 0.59-1.86); non-retron median 1.06 over THREE RNA-contacting chains
denominator: 15 retron chains with a defined Y
confounders: this is a LOCATION ratio, not enrichment evidence for specificity; the structural observations and the aggregate ratio are NOT independent strands (E-3C-7); contacts counted against whatever nucleic acid each entry contains
safe_thesis_wording: Region Y coincides with the structurally defined thumb and carries a modest, variable excess of RNA-contacting residues in a small retron panel. The classical reciprocal fragment-binding experiment covers exactly TWO retrons.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not call this specificity, enrichment evidence, or three independent strands.

claim: Mestre's published tree and table are reproducible as a reference object.
evidence: 18/18 scientific tables and 3/3 PNGs byte-identical after one declared root remap
confounders: the inputs manifest is NOT reproducible; s00 passes vacuously on a missing root; env.lock is an export of conda base
safe_thesis_wording: Mestre's published objects can be re-joined and re-plotted as a comparator.
prohibited_overclaim: This is not validation of the classification itself.

claim: Mestre's classification can be independently re-inferred from sequence.
evidence: <=3 of 11 clades recovered; the trees contain 91 of 112 substitute proteins, 3 of them RNA polymerase subunits; the same rule applied to the PUBLISHED tree gives 10/11
confounders: Mestre's alignment and RT0-RT7 extracts are NOT published and NOT on disk; no positive control was run in the prior attempt
safe_thesis_wording: Independent re-inference of the historical classification failed, and the material needed to diagnose why (the original alignment) does not exist locally.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not describe the historical classification as reproduced or independently validated.

claim: Phylogenetic PLACEMENT into the historical 11-clade system works with a validated discriminator.
evidence: control gate K3 FAILED: shuffled queries confidently placed at 7.9% (59/746, MCC-v3.1) and 19.8% (170/860, v2) against a <=1% limit; LWR shuffled median 0.998; Codex review FAIL 4.5/10
confounders: the non-retron panel 'PASS' (0/1,083) is 1,080 extraction failures - the confidence rule was never exercised on the negatives
safe_thesis_wording: The placement confidence rule is not a validated discriminator of non-homologous input; M2a is closed as a stopped, failed validation attempt.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not report the non-retron panel as a passed specificity control.

claim: A modern, label-independent de novo retron RT phylogeny fails.
evidence: no such analysis has been run in this project
confounders: the five 'failed tree routes' are PRIOR-PROJECT, UNVERIFIED here, and targeted different questions
safe_thesis_wording: Reproducing Mestre, placing sequences into the historical clade system, and inferring a modern de novo phylogeny are three different questions; only the first two have been attempted and failed.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not cite C-18 or C-19 as evidence that a modern phylogeny would fail.

claim: Retron ncRNAs can be discovered de novo by comparative covariation.
evidence: ROUND2_FAIL_STOP on a frozen held-out split: G1 enrichment 343 vs 118.9 expected = 2.88x against a required >=3x; G7 - a fixed positional interval finds 901 against the method's 343
confounders: truth coordinates are production-CM calls; covariation is non-specific (88% of distal windows, 100% of group II intron sets)
safe_thesis_wording: De novo comparative covariation did not outperform a fixed positional prior on held-out retron loci and was closed on its own predeclared criteria.
prohibited_overclaim: 'No novel retron ncRNA exists' is NOT claimable - the source states it is not evidence of absence.

claim: The SPIRE post-mortem yields reusable positional features for boundary work.
evidence: retron-enriched ~90-nt submotif: 1,793 instances, retron 140/164 (85%) vs non-retron 42/80 (52.5%), Fisher p = 1.0e-7, OR 5.3; per-type positional prior 969 (92.2%) at IoU>=0.5
confounders: the submotif overlaps the locus's own CM call 97.9% of the time, and the 21 CMs were themselves built by CMfinder - same-paradigm rediscovery
safe_thesis_wording: A retron-enriched upstream submotif and a type-conditioned positional prior are available as PRIORS for a future boundary model.
prohibited_overclaim: These are not a discovery of ncRNA families and may never be evaluated against CM-derived truth.

claim: Retron RT-ncRNA geometry is stereotyped.
status: ESTABLISHED as a description of detector output
evidence: 94.5% upstream, median gap 55 bp (IQR 27-1,037), 99.8% same strand, 94.41% zero CDS between
confounders: the covariance models were trained on msr-msd in this position - the bundle itself concedes the upstream and same-strand figures are partly circular
safe_thesis_wording: Detected retron ncRNAs sit immediately upstream of the RT on the same strand in the overwhelming majority of calls.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not present this geometry as an independent biological discovery.

claim: About half of retron loci carry no ncRNA.
evidence: zero-ncRNA class 298,850 of 630,741-632,688 Retron loci = 47.24%
confounders: carriage swings 6.6-fold with tool combination (89.23% -> 13.50%) and by subtype from 90.1% to 0%; 17 of 18 PADLOC retron rules score ON the ncRNA; upstream context length drives it (87.27% unmatched with <200 bp vs 42.91% with >=1 kb)
safe_thesis_wording: Among retron-labelled loci, 47.24% carry no detected ncRNA; this rate is a property of the detector combination and the available upstream context.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not present 47% as the biological fraction of retrons lacking an ncRNA.

claim: Frozen protein and RNA representations identify the observed partner above chance.
evidence: MRR 0.4407 [0.4039, 0.4772] vs chance 0.0900; permutation p = 0.0005; reverse direction 0.4738; near-duplicate-excluded change -0.008
confounders: 82.46% of held-out RTs have a >=0.50-identity training relative; 100% of held-out pairs are reachable from training by one modality
safe_thesis_wording: Cross-modal representations recover RT-ncRNA correspondence far above chance at the level of retron type / system class.
prohibited_overclaim: Does not establish generalisation to evolutionarily unrelated RT or ncRNA sequences.

claim: That retrieval signal is partner-specific beyond retron type.
evidence: rung 3 (type-matched decoys) +0.0298, 95% CI [-0.0048, +0.0633] - the predeclared margin is not cleared; escalation to g3 NOT AUTHORISED
confounders: 'retron type' IS the ncRNA's own covariance model, so the decoy control is an ncRNA-derived label
safe_thesis_wording: Matching decoys on retron type removes the retrieval advantage; the result is consistent with a true difference of zero and with an improvement of up to +0.063.
prohibited_overclaim: This is not equivalence and not a demonstrated null. Two of the five trivial baselines were inert by construction.

claim: Broad RT-lineage information predicts the cognate ncRNA.
confounders: this IS the lineage effect, measured deliberately
safe_thesis_wording: Conditioning on RT lineage (a 50%-identity homolog representative) substantially improves prediction of the cognate ncRNA over both no conditioning and the broad type label.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not present this as pair-specific information.

claim: The exact RT carries information beyond its own 50%-identity homolog group.
evidence: R - G = -0.00551 [-0.00797, -0.00312], 55.3% of components; same sign on 3/3 seeds but range -0.0055 to -0.0156 (sd 0.0051 ~= the point estimate); holds in T4 (-0.00499 [-0.00945, -0.00055], 247 components); near-duplicate sensitivity arm SPANS ZERO (-0.00210 [-0.00601, +0.00196])
confounders: G - T = -0.019 of R - T = -0.025, so the homolog group explains ~77% of the advantage over the type label; the permutation arm is NOT flat (P - T = -0.00590)
safe_thesis_wording: Specific RT sequence information provides a reproducible improvement beyond broad retron type AND beyond a coarse 50%-identity homolog representation; most of the gain is at the lineage level and the additional specific-RT effect is small and uncertain in magnitude across seeds.
prohibited_overclaim: Never report X2 as PASS/FAIL or quote a magnitude from one seed. The conclusion of record is the qualified paragraph, not the label X2-A.

claim: The model discriminates the observed RT from close alternatives at pair level.
evidence: counterfactual decay C1 +0.01766 -> C2 +0.01543 -> C3 +0.00397 -> C4 +0.00168 (~10-fold); at C3 only 52.5% of PAIRS favour the observed RT and the RAW PAIR-LEVEL MEAN is -0.000205 (median +0.000187)
confounders: alternatives at C3 are the 8 nearest RTs by frozen ESM-C cosine within the same fold
safe_thesis_wording: Under the strongest counterfactual controls the model does not cleanly separate the observed RT from its nearest sequence neighbours on a per-pair basis.
prohibited_overclaim: No per-pair biological inference whatsoever. A counterfactual RT is a conditioning control, never a negative pair; an absent combination is a NON-OBSERVED pairing.

claim: RT-ncRNA biochemical compatibility, interchangeability or orthogonality.
evidence: nothing in any arm measures binding, msDNA production or interchangeability; no local asset contains a swap, cross-reactivity or orthogonality experiment
safe_thesis_wording: Biochemical compatibility and orthogonality between retron RTs and non-cognate ncRNAs have not been tested by this project and cannot be tested with the assets currently held.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not convert a likelihood difference into a compatibility label, an interaction probability or a pair score, and do not report an AUROC against artificial mismatches.

claim: RT and ncRNA co-evolve beyond shared ancestry.
evidence: no phylogeny exists anywhere in this project; the contract's 'phylogenetically matched' control rung was never built
confounders: the prior co-variation result was V = 1.0000 BY CONSTRUCTION (msr_msd nested inside clade)
safe_thesis_wording: Co-evolution has not been tested: there is no null for shared ancestry.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not use the word co-evolution for any current result. Mantel tests are ruled out by prior decision; use a PP-style block-constrained permutation.

claim: The 175-element experimental panel is an independent validation set for this project's models.
evidence: exact-hash join: 58 TRAIN_EXPOSED, 33 VAL_TEST_EXPOSED, 56 CATALOGUE_ONLY, 12 SEQUENCE_NEAR, only 16 FULLY_EXTERNAL; 145/175 RTs are in the 501,561 catalogue; 175/175 carry a Mestre accession
confounders: X2 cross-fits ALL folds, so every split-present element is X2-exposed; the panel is 174/175 inside Mestre's own reference set
safe_thesis_wording: The experimental panel is an assay layer on the same prediction set the project analyses, not an independent benchmark; only 16 of 175 elements are fully external by sequence.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not call the panel independent validation. Do not call the 16 external elements a compatibility or orthogonality set - they carry FUNCTIONAL measurements, not exchangeability labels.

claim: The panel could support prospective external FUNCTIONAL validation.
evidence: 81 empirically determined RT-DNA sequences; RT-DNA production measured for 103 with 67 > 0; human editing > 0 for 100, bacterial 27, phage 16; 31 elements tested with outcome undetermined
denominator: 175 panel rows; 16 fully external + 56 catalogue-only usable with care
confounders: exposure classes are measured by exact hash, so a non-exposed subset can be declared in advance
safe_thesis_wording: A prospective analysis could test whether sequence-derived predictions of RT-DNA production or editing hold on elements outside a model's training exposure - a different endpoint from pairing specificity.
prohibited_overclaim: This endpoint is not orthogonality and must not be presented as evidence about RT-ncRNA pairing specificity.

claim: A 977-element experimentally validated retron ncRNA set exists.
evidence: two independent searches found no file with 977 records; nearest candidates hold 1,216 and 936 ncRNAs whose 'validated' flag means the RT protein matches Mestre 2020 (validated_ncrna true for only 165); no filter of the Mestre table yields 977
safe_thesis_wording: No 977-element experimentally validated ncRNA set exists locally, and no local document attributes one to Mestre 2020.
prohibited_overclaim: This set must not be cited, used as boundary truth, or used as a positive control.

claim: Neighbourhood composition discriminates retron loci from other RT loci.
evidence: retrons rank 27th of 41 RT families on Tier-A defence-accessory carriage; 53.50% vs 45.36% neighbour-matched; fold 1.179 [1.161, 1.198], inside a predeclared DEAD band
confounders: not re-derived in this project
safe_thesis_wording: Genomic neighbourhood composition is a poor discriminator of retron loci and cannot be used as an identification criterion.
prohibited_overclaim: This says nothing about whether neighbourhood architecture is biologically informative - that was never tested. All 41,250,531 accessory CDS lack sequences.

claim: Effector, fusion and operon architecture around retron RTs.
evidence: all 41,250,531 accessory CDS carry has_sequence = False; effector information exists only as PADLOC RULE DEFINITIONS; operon figures are illustrative examples supporting no rate
confounders: local InterProScan/Pfam is a STUB (3-4 profiles); a clean run against it is DATA_INADEQUATE, not a negative
safe_thesis_wording: Accessory and fusion architecture has not been measured in this project.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not infer effector prevalence from PADLOC rule definitions, and do not read the illustrative operon figures as rates.

claim: OpenCRISPR is a methodological precedent for this project's conditional modelling, not a source of evidence.
evidence: the released implementation was audited at code and checkpoint level (85/85 tensors load byte-identically; SpCas9 conditioning 16/16 well-formed; MalE 0/64); published methods were unretrievable (403/429) and recorded as an access limit
safe_thesis_wording: OpenCRISPR trained a protein-conditioned gRNA decoder and used conditional RNA likelihood to study Cas9-RNA exchangeability. This project audited that implementation and adapted reusable causal-decoder / cross-attention components; X1/X2 are an OpenCRISPR-inspired retron ADAPTATION, not a replication. The component-blocked split, the G/P arms and the C1-C4 hierarchy were introduced here to address retron sequence relatedness and lineage confounding.
prohibited_overclaim: Their training split, performance claims and biological negatives were NOT reused and must not be cited as this project's evidence.
